Set the operational effects of this disruption

Your description is shared with all three agents. Set measurable effects here; written text alone does not change runway, weather, fuel or gate limits.

Use Configure for gates, ground teams and taxiways; Edit each flight for fuel, arrival and crew inputs.

Why do all three agents check a revised plan?

A slot that works for ATC may leave too little fuel or clash with another gate booking. Each agent automatically rechecks its own limits against the same revised schedule. A previous approval applies only to that earlier schedule. You do not need to approve each check.
